[FFD24A]HOW THE UPGRADE BENCH WORKS[-]
1. Put in [FFD24A]2 of the same mod[-] at the [FFD24A]same quality[-].
2. The list next to the result shows what else it costs:
    parts (any ONE of the listed kinds) + forged iron or steel.
    [7FE37F]Green[-] = you have enough. [FF6060]Red[-] = you're short.
3. Materials must be in your backpack or toolbelt.
4. Press [FFD24A]Upgrade[-]: both mods + materials are used up,
    and you get ONE mod back, one quality level higher (max Q6).
[9A9A9A]Q2-Q3 use forged iron, Q4-Q6 use forged steel.[-]
